title: Sun Yingsha and Lin Shidong sweep into last 16 at WTT Champions Montpellier
standfirst: Sun dropped 14 points in her first match for about three weeks, Lin beat Lim Jonghoon in straight games, and Hina Hayata and An Jaehyun also went through on the opening day.
author: michael
body: Sun Yingsha and Lin Shidong both won in straight games on the opening day of WTT Champions Montpellier on Tuesday. Sun beat France's Camille Lutz 11-6, 11-5, 11-3, and Lin beat South Korea's Lim Jonghoon 11-7, 11-8, 11-2.

It was Sun's first match since her last-32 defeat at the China Smash, after which she missed the Asian Championships in Tashkent. She said afterwards, in comments carried by Sina Sports, that injury and illness had disrupted her training in recent months and that she had returned to a normal routine only about 10 days before travelling to France. She described her mindset in the match as very good.
Her next opponent is South Korea's Shin Yubin, who beat Cheng I-Ching 3-0 in the first match of the tournament.
Lin needed about 21 minutes. He trailed 0-6 in the second game before taking it 11-8, and lost only two points in the third. He meets An Jaehyun in the last 16 after An beat Egypt's Omar Assar 3-2.

Hina Hayata beat Hong Kong's Doo Hoi Kem 11-9, 11-7, 11-9 in just over 27 minutes. Doo led the first game 8-3 and called a timeout, but Hayata won eight of the last nine points. She now plays Romania's Bernadette Szőcs, who beat South Korea's Kim Nayeong 11-7, 12-10, 11-9.
Sweden's Elias Ranefur beat his teammate Anton Källberg 7-11, 8-11, 11-7, 12-10, 11-8, saving match points in the fourth game after a long break while a wound on his arm was treated.
In the evening session Félix Lebrun plays Denmark's Anders Lind, Chen Yi meets Peng Yu-han and the defending champion, Truls Moregard, takes on France's Thibault Poret.
